item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 19/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A dry northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Tuesday. The weather will be generally fine over the region midweek next week. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Besides, the broad area of low pressure over the western North Pacific will develop gradually and move towards the seas east of Luzon in the next few days. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement.
